metadata.division: DIVISION 1-1-1. TITLE, PURPOSE, AUTHORITY, AND APPLICABILITY

content.title: 1-1-1-3. Authority.
content.summary: This Code is enacted pursuant to the City of Arvada Home Rule Charter and the powers granted and limitations imposed on municipalities by the Constitution and laws of the State of Colorado, including without limitation C.R.S. § 29-20-101, et seq. (The Local Government and Land Use Enabling Act).
